instruction: Daylit Perimeter Split From Init Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input files init.osm and weather.epw. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 3 spaces and 3 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: SouthPerimeter, EastPerimeter and Core. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 19 total OS:Surface objects, split into 3 floor surfaces, 3 roof/ceiling surfaces and 13 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 3 Ground, 10 Outdoors and 6 Surface. Add 3 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 39.36 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 3 ideal-loads air systems, 3 zone HVAC equipment lists, 3 dual-setpoint thermostats, 1 people definition, 1 lights definition, 1 electric equipment definition and 2 daylighting controls. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 18.00 m in X, 12.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 216.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 192.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
